services.title: Business websites
services.text: A site that says clearly what you do and makes it easy to get in touch. Designed and built from scratch, fast on any phone.

services.title: Redesigns
services.text: Your site looks dated or breaks on phones? I rebuild it modern and responsive, and keep the content your customers already know.

services.title: Web applications
services.text: Bookings, accounts, dashboards: custom features in Java and Spring, for when a ready-made template won't do.

services.title: Care after launch
services.text: Small changes, updates and fixes, plus help with your domain, hosting and email, so the site keeps working for you.

process.title: Talk
process.text: You tell me about your business and what the site should do. Free, with no obligation.

process.title: Plan
process.text: I propose the structure, the look and a clear price before any work starts.

process.title: Build
process.text: You follow the progress on a private preview link and give feedback as it grows.

process.title: Launch
process.text: I put it live, check speed and search basics, and stay around for questions.
